pwd.description: Prints the absolute path of the current working directory.

cd.description: Change the current working directory. If none is given, change to home directory.

mkdir.description: Create directory(ies), if they do not already exist.

ls.description: List child directories and files of the directory (current directory by default).
ls.options: -a   Also list hidden files (Don't ignore entries starting with a dot).

tree.description: Recursively list all child files and directories of the directory (current directory by default) as tree structure. Limited to depth three for performance.
tree.options: -a   Also list hidden files (Don't ignore entries starting with a dot).

echo.options: -e   Allow the use of escape characters (like \n and \t).

touch.description: Create an empty file. If the file already exists, update the modification time.

head.description: Print the first line of file.

tail.description: Print the last line of file.

wc.description: Print newline, word, and byte counts of file.
wc.options:
-l   Print line count.
	-w   Print word count.
	-c   Print byte count.

sort.description: Print sorted concatenation of all file(s).

grep.description: Search file(s) for lines matching a text pattern.
grep.options:
-i   Ignore case distinctions.
	-v   Select non matching lines instead.
	-c   Print total number of matching lines.

cp.description: Copy source file to target file or into target directory.

mv.description: Move source file to target file or directory, or rename source file to target file.

rm.options: -r   Remove directories and their contents recursively.

ping.description: Send a HTTP HEAD request to server and get time in ms.

curl.description: Send an HTTP request to server and get site contents.

gdpt.description: Install or update a library of commands in the from of a .gd file. Update overrides existing libraries of the same name, install does not.
gdpt.options:
-r   Install fron url, send HTTP request and install contents as library.
	-t   Temporary install, don't save to disk.

uname.description: Print system information. If no optionns are givien the OS name is printed.
uname.options:
-a   Print all information.
	-s, -o   Print OS name
	-r   Print OS version and it's alias.
	-n   Print hostname.
	-m, -p, -i   Print CPU architecture

help.description: Print name and short information for command(s). If none is given, print information for all commands.

man.description: Print name, information and options for command.

history.description: Print history of entered commands, numbered

reset.description: Resets the terminal. Does not clear save data and styling.

colors.description: Prints all the colors of the terminal.
colors.options: -a   Also print hidden colors (black, bg, caret, selection and selected)
